name: College of Lore
summary: Bards who collect knowledge from every source and cut enemies down with words.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.short: Three extra skills of your choice.
features.summary: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.short: Reaction: spend Bardic Inspiration to weaken a roll.
features.summary: When a creature within 60 ft. makes an attack roll, ability check or damage roll, you can use your reaction and a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract the roll from its result, after it rolls but before you know the outcome.

features.name: Additional Magical Secrets
features.short: Learn two spells from any class.
features.summary: You learn two spells of your choice from any class. They must be of a level you can cast, and they count as bard spells for you.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.short: Add a Bardic Inspiration die to your own ability check.
features.summary: When you make an ability check, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and add the die to the check, after rolling but before knowing the outcome.
